notes: I fit a cubic polynomial (least squares) to the E1 data, since the outputs look like a smooth odd-ish function (large negative for large positive x, small near 0). This is my best guess at the underlying MLP-approximated function; a cubic captures the shape better than a pure cubic-only or linear fit. Marked as a hypothesis — more probes would confirm whether it's cubic, tanh-based, or piecewise.
